channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Handed Nicotine Rules Should be Eliminated to Help Smokers Quit
item.description: Pennsylvania's new nicotine regulations under Act 57 could significantly restrict access to smoke-free alternatives, with only 159 products included on the state's approved list. (Published on October 21, 2026byprotectingtaxpayers.org)

item.title: Teen Nicotine Use is at a 50-Year Low
item.description: Nicotine use among American teenagers may be at its lowest level in 50 years, according to an analysis of long-term national survey data by Charles A. Gardner. (Published on October 21, 2026bymedium.com)
